# EU VAT Validation Oracle (x402)

> Machine-native VIES VAT validation oracle on Base L2 via x402 payment protocol.

## Service Details
- URL: https://vat-oracle.onrender.com/v1/vat/validate
- Method: GET
- Price: 0.02 USDC
- Network: Base Mainnet (Chain ID 8453)
- Recipient: 0x8a07325f802523BC245b4A3278CdBb0eF492a14E

## Parameters
- country (required): 2-letter ISO country code (e.g., DE, IE, FR)
- vat_number (required): EU VAT number without country prefix

## Payment Flow
1. Query endpoint -> receive 402 Payment Required.
2. Sign/send 0.02 USDC on Base Mainnet.
3. Pass tx hash in `x-payment-tx-hash` header.
